description: Tell AlterLab when something is hard. Call this when something blocks you, a result is wrong, or a step is confusing, slow or priced unexpectedly. Describe what you tried, what happened and what you expected. Do not include secrets, API keys, passwords or customer data; use a job_id or hostname instead of page content. Works without an API key (rate limited per IP); with a key the report is also linked privately to your organization for follow-up. Returns a cluster_key and a status_url to check progress.

tool_name.description: Tool or endpoint the report is about

url.description: Target URL; only its hostname is kept
